## Checklist

- [ ] Followed the [Pre-Commit Checklist](../CLAUDE.md#pre-commit-checklist)
- [ ] `flutter analyze` clean (no errors)
- [ ] `flutter test` passes (if there are relevant tests)
- [ ] Commit message follows [Conventional Commits](../CLAUDE.md#git--commit-convention)
- [ ] No leftover `print()` / `debugPrint()` debugging
- [ ] No secrets / API keys / credentials committed
- [ ] Correct target branch (`dev` for features, `main` only for release/hotfix)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated if the change is user-facing
